title: IBIA 2026: Don't Expect Agreement on IMO NZF to Spell End of EU ETS — Ship & Bunker
summary: The industry's supposed 'adaptation' to future IMO Net-Zero Frameworks will not alleviate the immediate financial burden of the EU ETS. Operators must proactively reduce carbon intensity now to mitigate substantial FuelEU Maritime fines, irrespective of slow international consensus. This forced compliance exposes the industry's reactive strategy, where genuine deep decarbonization too often remains a distant, unfulfilled promise.
